initial.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production transparent BODY-ONLY sprite sheet for Battle of Gods, matching reference 1 King's exact small body, dark outline and palette; reference 2 is the newly approved Twinsteel V2 side combo. Spiky charcoal hair, crimson scarf, dark blue charcoal short tunic with pale silver shoulders/hem, brown closed gloves and boots. SAME short body and head size across every cel. Complete connected arms, intact neck/scarf/chest, NO weapons, handles, VFX, shadows, guides, text, grid or background. Pixel art clusters with crisp dark edges, not vector art. EXACTLY FIVE rows of EIGHT separated complete bodies. LARGE transparent gutters. Each row: ready, anticipation, loaded, first contact, sweep, followthrough, settle, ready. No figure touches another. All grounded soles consistent. These are new animations of the same King, not new character variants. UP/BACK view: the character's back faces the camera and he attacks screen UP away from us. All non-spin figures show only back hair, scarf back, back vest. Arms pass beside shoulders or are genuinely occluded behind the torso at contact; no front-face/front-chest pasted into rear poses. Both visible fists attached. Spin starts and ends back-facing, traverses right/front/left/back; maintain fixed proportions. Row1 diagonal descending near-hand sweep, other fist by hip; Row2 opposite-hand rising return cut; Row3 paired rising crosscut, two separate fists open outward; Row4 small hopping full spin with whole-body turns, never scale up; Row5 short springing two-arm crossing downward finisher, landing braced. Body momentum sharp and readable; NOT an opening thrust. Arms represent a short sword in EACH hand.
